CustomField.description: Comma-separated API names of the Lead fields that go with this stage (the internal process requires them). The portal's Edit popup shows them, with those of the Previous Stages, but a channel partner may leave any of them empty. Loss Reason Other goes with Other Loss Reason.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Comma-separated API names of the Lead fields of this stage. On the portal they are optional for channel partners.
CustomField.label: Required Lead Fields
